Round 3 unified stage language: integrate black-box theater, shared light beams, floor marks, haze, recurring transferable prop motifs, coherent color lanes.

Asset ID: scene_medical_rescue_plateau
Asset type: scene
Primary request: Medical rescue plateau stage concept, center-back cold white light, six medical figures moving into wind, white rescue bags, orange reflective accents, mobile CT silhouette, slanted snow-light beams, dark stage void with breath haze
Prompt pattern: Theatrical stage concept art, wide establishing view from audience eye level, full stage spatial layout, foreground/midground/background layers, visible lighting design and practical props, no audience, no readable signage.
Research anchors: Sanxingdui bronze/gold/earth for archaeology; West China Hospital plateau medical rescue gear for medical lane; GRID student satellite and lab-blue cube for technology lane.
Style: high-end Chinese recital drama stage concept design, symbolic but practical for theater production, photorealistic concept art with designerly restraint.
Lighting: visible theatrical beams, controlled haze, black-box stage depth, area color washes, practical glowing props.
Composition: professional art department board, elegant negative space, clear silhouette, no text overlays.
Quality: detailed fabric weave, worn material texture, realistic contact shadows, coherent palette, no plastic skin, no airbrushing, no digital oversharpening.
Negative prompt: no readable text, no watermark, no extra fingers, no deformed hands, no broken limbs, no duplicate faces, no Japanese kimono, no samurai, no shrine, no sci-fi armor, no astronauts, no fake logos, no cluttered chaos, no sterile showroom, no cartoon.

Unified round tone: elegant tri-color stage system, black velvet depth, soft haze, precise floor marks, warm gold left lane, cold white center lane, electric blue right lane, coordinated like one production bible.
Aspect ratio requirement: 16:9 wide frame for every asset in this round, so the set feels coordinated on one presentation wall.
